subject: what pro actually unlocks
preheader: free is great. here's what $29.99 a month buys you.
headline: The free tier handles most rentals. Pro is for everything else.
body: Free tier covers the basics: paste an address, get cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, NOI, and a verdict. For most single-family rental decisions, that's enough. Use it forever, no card required.

Pro is $29.99/mo or $300/yr. What it adds: 10-year projections with rent and expense growth. MAO calculator for flips. Sensitivity grids across rent and expense scenarios. BRRRR analyzer with ARV and refi modeling. Fix-and-flip analyzer with holding costs and timeline. PDF reports you can send to lenders, partners, or clients. Saved deal history. Mortgage scenario A/B compare (75% LTV vs 80% LTV, 30-yr vs 25-yr, etc). Rehab estimator with line-item costs.

If you only do straightforward buy-and-hold, free is fine. If you do BRRRR, flips, or you analyze enough deals that PDFs and saved scenarios matter, Pro pays for itself the first time it catches something you would've missed.
$300/yr works out to $25/mo. That's less than one hour of a junior analyst, less than a cheap dinner out, and less than a single hour of an inspector you'd hire on a bad deal you didn't catch.
There's a 3-day Pro trial for first-time subscribers if you want to test the upgraded features against a real deal you're working before deciding. Cancel before it ends and you won't be charged.
